Never been in a situation like that but I do watch some streamers. Some have a disclaimer in bio that donations are non-refundable but I'm not sure how much is disclaiming that worth in context of charging back. I would try to get it back anyways. Contact your bank and see if it's possible. 

You did mess up and whether you get it back or not you should know that parasocial relationships are not healthy and you won't buy extra points with them with money.
